verdicts.about: Name Google's public DNS in the privacy line, since .io/.co/.me go to dns.google
verdicts.why: Answered in the session: "so what -- nothing reaches our server anyway", and the line naming Google read as heavy. The proposal's fallback, keep only "we never see them", is roughly what shipped; its main fix was turned down.

verdicts.about: A "Copying image…" toast at once, switched to "copied" when the write lands
verdicts.why: Answered in the session: "Copying image…" taken ("окей"), the text switch questioned ("тост же вылазит"); of the two shapes offered, the operator chose the menu item showing the wait over one toast changing its text.
